prompt: launch video for a note-taking app

plan.title: Meet the Note App That Keeps Up With You
plan.description: A 30-second launch video for a new note-taking app that helps you capture ideas fast and find them again. Simple notes, quick search, and everything in one place.

beats.narration: You had a brilliant idea this morning. Where is it now? Lost in a scrap of paper, or buried in a messy phone.
Meet our new note-taking app. Capture a thought quickly, organize it, and find it again later.
Your notes stay organized and close at hand. Less hunting, more thinking. Download it today, and keep your good ideas safe.

props.title: Never lose an idea again
props.subtitle: Our new note-taking app is here

warnings: length: the narration totals 68 words in 3 beats but a 30-second video needs about 58 (between 52 and 58). Cut about 10 words: 3 to 4 beats of about 19 words each (you averaged 22; count the words of every beat), one idea, no preamble and no recap; keep the hook and the last line
grounding: 2 beats had unsupported specifics, 2 rewritten
